mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (username, password, nickname, email, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{email}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET nickname = #{nickname}, avatar = #{avatar}, sexy = #{sexy}, birthday = #{birthday}, email = #{email}, phone_number = #{phone_number}, location = #{location}, detail_address = #{detail_address}, update_time = NOW() WHERE username = #{username}
